text.div:
SYNTHETIC RECORD, NOT A REAL MEDICAL RECORD

  • Dual antiplatelet therapy with aspirin 81 mg and ticagrelor 90 mg twice daily for twelve months after the infarction, then aspirin alone
  • High-intensity atorvastatin with ezetimibe added for LDL cholesterol above 55 mg/dL; recheck lipids 4 to 12 weeks after the change, then every 3 to 12 months
  • Metoprolol succinate and lisinopril for blood pressure below 130/80; basic metabolic panel 1 to 2 weeks after an ACE inhibitor change, then every 6 months; reassess the beta-blocker at one year
  • Cardiology consultation to establish local cardiology care, reassess left ventricular function, and advise on return to full-time work and on the duration of antiplatelet and beta-blocker therapy
  • After cardiac rehabilitation, a home maintenance program of brisk walking and golf, a Mediterranean-style diet, staying tobacco free, PHQ-2 depression screening at visits, and a written chest-pain plan with sublingual nitroglycerin
  • Yearly influenza vaccine, pneumococcal vaccine, RSV vaccine, and current COVID-19 vaccine

resource.title: Dwight D. Eisenhower synthetic care plan
resource.description: Take over the care of a 65-year-old executive four months after an anterior myocardial infarction treated with a stent, and carry him through the first year on the CMID schedule: twelve months of dual antiplatelet therapy, a lipid goal reached with ezetimibe, blood pressure control, reassessment of left ventricular function, depression screening, staying tobacco free, and a safe return to full-time work after cardiac rehabilitation.
